name: ai-harness
description: Unified AI agent platform combining CLI and Web interfaces

scripts.dev:cli: npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/core && npm run dev --workspace @ai-harness/cli
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/core && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @ai-harness/server" "npm run dev --workspace @ai-harness/web"
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/core && concurrently --kill-others --names cli,api,web "npm run dev --workspace @ai-harness/cli" "npm run dev --workspace @ai-harness/server" "npm run dev --workspace @ai-harness/web"
scripts.web: npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/core && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run start --workspace @ai-harness/server" "npm run dev --workspace @ai-harness/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/core && npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/cli && npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/server && npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/web
scripts.link:global: npm run build && (cd packages/cli && npm link) && (cd packages/server && npm link)
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @ai-harness/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rm -rf node_modules dist .turbo
